c: On the incident, the side panel has Templates, Response Templates and Email template; Compose Email is in the ⋯ menu.
say: On an incident, the side panel has three template icons: templates, response templates and email template. Compose email is in the more actions menu.

c: Templates fills in fields. Preview, then Apply, then save. You see global templates, your own and your groups'. On pdi2 none is shared yet.
say: Templates fill in fields of the incident. Preview the changes, apply, then save. You only see global templates, your own and your groups' templates, and on pdi2 none is shared yet.

c: Response Templates: choose a message such as Need more information; the caller's name and the short description are filled in. Copy to clipboard.
say: Response templates give you a prepared message, with the caller's name and the short description filled in. Copy it to the clipboard. On pdi2 only administrators have the role to see them.

c: Paste into Additional comments or Work notes, or use the quick action r with a keyword while typing.
say: Paste it into the additional comments or the work notes, or use the response template quick action while you type.

c: ⋯ › Compose Email writes an email from the incident. In the body, r inserts a response template. pdi2 has no email template for incident.
say: Compose email writes an email from the incident. In the body, the r quick action inserts a response template. There is no email template for incidents on pdi2.

c: Applied the wrong template? Undo template puts the last values back before you save.
say: If you applied the wrong template, undo template puts the previous values back.
